jobs.description:
Job Description
Here at Kraft Heinz, we grow our people to grow our business, because we believe that great people make great companies. When you join our table, you can expect access to an array of holistic wellness benefits* and perks, including medical, dental and vision coverage, 7% 401(k) matching, Business Resource Groups (BRGs) to help foster diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all employees, an industry-leading total rewards package that emphasizes a high discretionary bonus.  *Benefits begin 30 days after hire for hourly employees, and immediately upon hire for salaried employees.    Get a peek into life here at Kraft Heinz through our Instagram and TikTok channels!

Finance Manager, Management Reporting & Data Foundation – Americas, Supply Chain at a glance….
The Manager of Management Reporting & Data Foundation – Americas, Supply Chain supports the execution of the supply chain management reporting framework and financial data governance strategy across the Americas (North, South, and Central) finance organizations. This role applies standardized methodologies, tools, and processes to ensure consistent, high-quality financial insights with a focus on COGS P&L line items, including material cost, variable and fixed manufacturing cost, logistics cost, and related KPIs, across functions, business units, and leadership teams. The role ensures supply chain reporting standards, financial KPIs, and data definitions are aligned to global standards while supporting improvements in data quality, reporting automation, and analytical capabilities for the finance organization.

What’s on the menu?
Management Reporting Leadership
·         Support and execute the supply chain management reporting framework, including definitions, standards, and methodologies for COGS and related supply chain P&L metrics
·         Maintain and update standardized supply chain financial KPIs and metrics, ensuring consistent application across the Americas organizations
·         Support the development and maintenance of supply chain reporting packages, dashboards, and financial insights for Americas leadership teams
·         Ensure alignment of supply chain reporting structures across Americas FP&A, business units, and finance teams

Financial Data Governance & Quality
·         Apply and maintain financial data governance policies, standards, and controls for supply chain data elements
·         Execute data quality improvement initiatives for supply chain finance data across systems and reporting platforms
·         Support the definition and management of ownership models for supply chain financial data elements and master data
·         Partner with data, IT, and digital teams to ensure supply chain data integrity across enterprise platforms

Reporting Tools & Platforms
·         Leverage finance reporting tools and platforms to deliver supply chain management reporting outputs
·         Support the adoption of modern reporting solutions, self-service analytics, and visualization tools within the supply chain finance team
·         Ensure supply chain reporting outputs align with enterprise data architecture and technology strategy

Cross-Functional Collaboration
·         Partner with FP&A, procurement finance, manufacturing finance, logistics finance, zone finance, controllership, and IT Finance teams to align and implement supply chain reporting frameworks
·         Serve as the key point of contact for supply chain reporting standards and data definitions within the Americas finance organizations

Continuous Improvement
·         Identify and implement opportunities to automate supply chain reporting processes and reduce manual work
·         Drive best-practice adoption for supply chain reporting across Americas markets

Leadership & Team
·         Support and develop team members responsible for supply chain reporting and financial data quality
·         Build capabilities in supply chain financial analytics, reporting design, and data governance within the team
- undefined

- BS in Finance-Accounting, Economics, or other related field required
- 5+ years of experience in FP&A, supply chain reporting, or finance transformation
- Experience in multinational CPG or complex global organizations preferred
- Strong background in supply chain management reporting, COGS KPI frameworks, and financial analytics
- Experience with COGS P&L reporting, SAP systems (material ledger), and Essbase reporting tools
- Data governance and data quality frameworks
- Advanced analytics and reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)

The   Lead HR -  Technical University   is res ponsible for   desig ning and leading the company’s Supply Chain/Manufacturing Technical Learning ecosystem to develop world-class skilled trades and technical professionals. This leader will build a scalable “Technical University” that develops capabilities across Maintenance, Operations, Quality, Engineering, and Skilled Trades while creating clear career pathways that attract, develop, and   retain   talent.

This newly created HR leadership role will partner closely with Operations leadership, HR, COE's, and external education partners to ensure the organization develops the Technical Capabilities required for sustainable business growth

The   Lead HR  Technical University will   establish   a modern learning model that combines classroom instruction, digital learning, hands-on training, certifications, and apprenticeship pathways.

Success is measured by the impact on employee capability, engagement, and alignment with Kraft Heinz’s mission to grow and elevate technical excellence.

Strategy & Vision

- Define and implement the long-term strategy and vision for the Technical University aligned with business and workforce needs.

- Build a scalable learning ecosystem for skilled trades, maintenance, quality, engineering technicians, and frontline technical roles.

- Establish competency models, certification frameworks, and structured career progression for technical talent.

- Skill attainment

- Certification rates

- Productivity improvements

- Retention of technical talent

- Maintenance and reliability

- Electrical and mechanical systems

- Automation and controls

- Safety and regulatory compliance

- Quality

- Create a culture of continuous learning and technical mastery across the organization.

jobs.title: Category Finance Manager
jobs.location: Freshwater, Victoria, Australia
jobs.description:
Job Description

Category Finance Manager
- Opportunity to grow your career with Kraft Heinz!
- Flexible work arrangement – 3 days in office, 2 days remote
- Collaborative and dynamic work environment

Kickstart Your Career with Kraft Heinz!
Are you looking to grow your career in  Finance ? Do you want to join a dynamic team with a proven track record of internal growth and career advancement opportunities? We have an exciting permanent opportunity for a  Category Finance Manager  to join our  Finance  team, based in  Southbank . Help turn strategy into action by supporting delivery of the category 3YP then driving in year execution of initiatives that align with the strategy.

Key position responsibilities include, but not limited to:
- Own P&L stewardship for the cluster, maintaining a clear view of revenue, margin, costs and key value drivers to support delivery of financial commitments and sustainable growth.
- Lead performance analysis and action planning, translating financial and commercial results into clear insights, risks, opportunities and practical interventions for category and cluster leaders.
- Be the linchpin that partners with Category, Sales, Marketing, RGM, other Finance teams and other cross-functional stakeholders to inform portfolio strategy, pricing, promotional activity, investment priorities and resource-allocation decisions.
- Develop and challenge robust business cases and investment recommendations, applying advanced financial modelling and commercial judgement to assess value, trade-offs, risks and expected returns.
- Lead the cluster forecasting and strategic planning processes, ensuring assumptions are evidence-based, aligned with category plans and translated into accurate, timely and actionable financial outlooks.
- Protect in-year delivery while shaping portfolio, investment and long-term growth choices.

What you'll bring
- 10+ years in commercial/category finance leadership, planning, business cases, RGM and senior stakeholder influence
- Experience in FMCG preferred.
- Finance, accounting or related degree
- CA or CPA Qualified
- Demonstrate strong commercial and strategic judgement, linking financial performance, category dynamics, and customer/consumer insights to enterprise priorities and value creation.
- Advanced capability in financial modelling, scenario analysis, and investment appraisal, including assessing complex assumptions, sensitivities, trade-offs, risks, and returns.
- Deep expertise in P&L management, forecasting, strategic planning, and performance management, grounded in key value drivers (revenue, margin, cost, cash).
- Good understanding of Revenue Growth Management across pricing, promotion, mix, trade investment, and portfolio optimisation as P&L levers.
- Able to translate complex financial and commercial data into clear insights, recommendations, and action plans for senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
- Highly developed stakeholder management and influencing skills, including confidently challenging assumptions and shaping senior-level decisions and alignment.
- Executive-level communication and presentation skills, conveying complex topics succinctly and tailoring messages for financial and non-financial audiences.
- Strong people leadership and coaching capability, including setting direction, prioritising resources, building commercial finance capability, and maintaining high delivery standards.

Why Join Us?
- Be part of a global food company with a rich history and iconic brands
- Collaborate with a talented team and contribute to our company's vision
- Develop your skills and expertise in a dynamic and supportive environment

﻿Ready to make an Impact?
If you're a Finance professional, a collaborative team player, and passionate about delivering value, we want to hear from you. We will review applications on a rolling basis and reserve the right to close this job posting at any time.

Freshwater

jobs.description:
About the role

At Kraft Heinz, our Finance team plays a critical role in creating and protecting value through strategic insights, rigorous analysis, and process excellence. We are looking for a seasoned FP&A Lead to join our UKI Business Unit Finance Organization. This role is pivotal in shaping financial strategy, enabling business decisions, and driving performance visibility across the region.

The FP&A Lead will oversee strategic business planning, forecasting, and process optimization, ensuring data integrity and analytical accuracy across systems. Reporting into the Finance Director, this position manages two direct reports and a team of 5 people and key stakeholder to Leadership Team for the UKI BU and Zone.

Key Responsabilities:
- Lead UKI Business Unit financial planning, including Annual Operating Plan (AOP), Monthly Forecast Process and the Financial Month Closing.
- Partner with business leaders to translate strategy into actionable financial plans, supporting decision-making through robust modelling and deep insights.
- Drive process optimization and leverage technology for greater data accuracy and visibility, ensuring adoption of Single Source of Truth (SST) practices.
- Manage and mentor the FP&A Commercial and ZBB teams to deliver accurate and timely reporting, analysis, and system-driven efficiencies.
- Ensure compliance with internal controls and finance policies, while contributing to the transformation of finance processes through digital tools.
- Collaborate on initiatives related to Zero-Based Budgeting, Price-Volume-Mix (PVM) analysis, and cost-benefit evaluations.

Key Capabilities and Tools
- Strategic Planning & Forecasting
- Financial Analysis & Modeling
- Cost-Benefit Analysis
- Data Democratization & Process Automation
- Systems: Tableau, Power BI, SAP, Hyperion, SST, ZBB tools

Qualifications
- Proven experience in Financial Planning & Analysis within a complex, fast-paced environment.
- Strong leadership experience with direct people management.
- Advanced technical proficiency in Tableau, Power BI, and Excel.
- Exceptional communication and business partnering skills.
- Ability to navigate ambiguity and deliver results with agility and precision.

What you’ll need
- 6+ years’ finance roles experience

- Strong strategic and commercial mindset

- Ability to influence and operate credibly with senior leaders

- Ability to structure ambiguous problems and turn imperfect data into clear, actionable recommendations

- Highly analytical; comfortable working with large and messy datasets

- Experience conducting stakeholder interviews and synthesising insights

- Collaborative working style , strong interpersonal skills

- Bachelor’s degree (minimum)

Professional Attributes

- Influencing & Relationship building - At Kraft Heinz you’ll work in a highly cross-functional, fast-paced environment, often needing to influence decisions without formal authority. Therefore it’s important you can build trusted relationships quickly and align diverse stakeholders to drive results

- Communication Skills - At Kraft Heinz you’ll be exposed to senior management, no matter your level. Therefore it’s important you have excellent communication skills to deal with all kinds of different stakeholders.

- Resilience - You’re able to recover after a disappointment or set back, and a demanding and dynamic environment is what keeps you energized.

- Ability to Simplify - We like to keep it simple, and execute fast. You are able to bring simple solutions to complex challenges.

- Analytical - We’re a very data driven company. You know how to translate complex data into a simple solution.

- Curiosity, positivity & enthusiasm - You have a growth mindset, and people know you as the motivator of your team.

- Great teammate - Achieving with the team is simply the best. You’re a team player, which means you’re sometimes a leader, sometimes a follower, but always working towards the same common goal, together.

What we offer you

- An ambitious employer with an industry-recognised career development pathway
- A meritocratic, pay for performance approach
- A fun, collaborative office culture that celebrates good food and good times with regular events and socials
- An active network of Business Resource Groups, sponsored by leadership, that promote education, celebration, & allyship, helping to create an inclusive work environment
- Flexible and hybrid working approach, including ability to work from abroad
- Family-friendly; market leading parental leave benefits & sponsored nursery scheme

Wellbeing

- Private medical cover & Digital GP
- Comprehensive Life Assurance & Group Income Protection
- Exclusive gym discounts & cycle to work scheme
- Premium membership to Calm App
- A variety of amazing sports teams & clubs!
- 3 volunteering days per year (e.g. Soup Kitchen, Magic Breakfast)

As a Disability Confident employer, we are happy to accommodate any reasonable adjustments you may need during our screening and interview process.

jobs.description:
Job Description
Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Intern

What’s on the menu

We have an excellent opportunity for an enthusiastic Bachelor or Master student who is interested in making a difference in Finance at Kraft Heinz!
Build a strong understanding of how financial planning, reporting and analysis support business decisions at Kraft Heinz. As part of the FP&A team, you will help transform financial data into actionable insights that support the performance of some of the world's most iconic food brands.
Kraft Heinz offers a fast-moving and collaborative environment in which ownership, curiosity and practical problem-solving are valued. The internship is designed to combine hands-on experience with learning: you will contribute to current business priorities, receive guidance from experienced colleagues and become part of the wider intern community.
If you share our passion and are ready to create the future, build a legacy, and lead as a global citizen, there's only one thing to do: Join our table and let's make life delicious!

The position

You will support the FP&A team within the Eastern Europe business and contribute to financial planning, forecasting, performance reporting and decision support activities.
Working closely with Finance colleagues as well as Sales, Marketing, Category and Supply Chain teams, you will help ensure that business performance is accurately tracked and translated into clear insights. The role offers broad exposure to core finance processes, from month-end reporting and forecasting cycles to budget management and performance analysis.
As an intern at Kraft Heinz, you will be trusted with meaningful responsibilities from the start. Alongside your day-to-day work, you will have opportunities to develop your analytical and business partnering skills, learn how different functions work together and build relationships across an international organization. You will receive support from experienced colleagues while being encouraged to take ownership of projects and deliverables.

What you’ll do

- Lead & execute the forecast financialization process using available Masterdata and inputs from different stakeholders
- Assist with month-end closing activities and help ensure the accuracy and consistency of financial data
- Prepare financial reports, dashboards and management presentations
- Analyze business performance, identify key variances, trends and risks, and support the development of recommendations
- Support marketing and commercial spend tracking, budget management and financial controls
- Maintain and improve master data quality and support data validation activities
- Assist with purchase order and invoice management processes
- Support ad hoc analyses, process improvement initiatives and automation projects

Job requirements
- You are enrolled at a European university for at least 50% of the duration of the internship (for EU citizens) or you are enrolled at a Dutch university for the full duration of the internship (for non-EU students).
- Advanced MS EXCEL proficiency ; ability to process the big datasets & work efficiently within multiple data sources
- Knowledge of Power BI or SAP is a plus
- Strong written and verbal English skills

NOTE: EU working rights are required (Either you have EU Citizenship, or you are studying in the Netherlands).

Professional Attributes
- Analytical mindset : You quickly understand volume, revenue and profitability drivers, turning complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
- Stakeholder Management : You build strong relationships across teams, collaborate effectively with different stakeholders and bring a constructive mindset that helps drive better business decisions.
- Ownership : You take initiative, proactively structure analyses and follow through on commitments to support business planning and decision-making.
- Communication Skills : You will easily be exposed to senior management. Therefore, it’s important you can communicate clearly and confidently with a wide range of stakeholders.
- Ability to Simplify : We like to keep it simple and to execute fast. Your ability to simplify complex challenges and turn them into practical solutions will be highly valued.
- Time Management Skills : You are organized, structured, and always have an overview of all the deliverables.
- Willingness to learn : You are quick and eager to pick up new skills and enjoy developing yourself in many areas.

Note: The recruitment process can take up to 4/6 weeks in total

·       Allowance : 625 euro per month (40hrs, 5 days) & full reimbursement of travel expenses.

Finance Lead, Global FP&A - P&L at a Glance….
This is one of the highest-exposure seats in Kraft Heinz FP&A. You own the total-company P&L story: how Kraft Heinz measures, explains, and steers performance across every region and function. When leadership asks “how are we tracking, and why,” the answer runs through you.

You’ll consolidate the global view, pressure-test the drivers, and turn complex financial results into a clear, decision-ready narrative for company leadership. Much of what the CFO and the Finance Leadership Team see, and what ultimately reaches the Board and the earnings either originates from or passes through this role. It demands range: the judgment to see the whole company, and the precision to get every number right.

You’ll report into Global FP&A leadership with direct, recurring exposure to the CFO and the broader Finance Leadership Team. This is a leadership-and-influence role – you’ll set the pace across regions and functions, earning alignment through clarity, credibility, and command of the numbers.

This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days onsite weekly at our office in Chicago.

What’s on the menu?

- Own total-company performance reporting. Consolidate and analyze region-level actuals and forecasts into a single, coherent global view of the P&L down to Net Income, with risks and opportunities clearly framed.
- Lead performance measurement. Track results against AOP, guidance, consensus, and commitments; validate key accruals and account balances (e.g., bonus payout, share-based comp, central hedge) to ensure financial statement integrity alongside Controllership.
- Create board- and earnings-grade materials. Design and build the leadership / board-level reports, dashboards, and narratives, support quarterly earnings content, internal communications from townhalls to leadership conferences – translate complex results into clear, actionable stories for senior audiences.

- Partner on earnings and IR. Work closely with External Reporting and Investor Relations through the quarterly close, providing the analysis and reconciliations that support earnings materials and the external narrative.
- Continuous improvement. Partner with GFIN/GSST and Finance Transformation to deliver system enhancements, automation, and durable models, tools, and templates that raise the quality and speed of FP&A.
- Lead and grow the team of finance professionals you're proud of, with a clear focus on capability-building and retention.
- Financial scope: total global P&L of ~$25B NSV / ~$5B OI / ~$3B Net Income — with a direct hand in the consolidation of the company forecast, including risks and opportunities.
- Impact: global, cross-functional influence spanning Investor Relations, Controllership, Tax, GBE Ops and ZBB, Communications and the Performance Team, and regional FP&A counterparts across three regions.
- Leadership: directly lead a team of two (manager and senior analyst) and indirectly steer the regional FP&A teams through the monthly business cycle: aligning and coordinating planning and reporting across the company.

- FP&A and reporting depth. Strong command of financial close, consolidation, forecasting, and performance measurement in a global, complex business.
- Senior-stakeholder presence. You can take a complicated performance story and make it land with various audiences, from the Board / leadership team and senior stakeholders to general company-wide audience. You need to be clear, concise, and decision-oriented.
- Precision under pressure. Exceptional attention to detail and a track record of getting the numbers right when the timelines are tight and the audience is senior.

Organisational Change Management Lead – ANZ Business Transformation

About the opportunity

We’re embarking on a major ANZ business transformation, reshaping the way our teams work, our processes operate and how we enable our business for the future.

As the Organisational Change Management Lead, you’ll play a pivotal role in making this transformation successful. Working alongside senior leaders and business teams across ANZ, you’ll lead the people and change agenda for a major transformation program, ensuring our organisation is ready to adopt new processes, ways of working and capabilities.

While SAP S/4HANA is an important enabler of the transformation, this is fundamentally a business change role, not an IT role.

What you’ll do

- Lead the organisational change strategy across a major ANZ transformation program.
- Partner with senior leaders and business stakeholders to build alignment, engagement and ownership.
- Identify business and people impacts and translate them into practical change and readiness plans.
- Lead communications, engagement, training and adoption activities across impacted teams.
- Build change capability and networks across the organisation to support sustainable adoption.
- Work closely with program and business leaders to identify and manage readiness risks and barriers.
- Track and communicate change progress, priorities and risks to program leadership.

What you’ll bring

- Experience leading organisational change, business transformation or large-scale implementation programs.
- Strong understanding of business processes, operating models and the impact of change on people and teams.
- Proven ability to influence and partner with senior leaders and diverse stakeholder groups.
- Strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills.
- Experience translating complex business change into practical plans for communication, readiness, training and adoption.
- A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the ability to operate confidently in a complex, matrixed environment.
- Experience with SAP, ERP or other large scale technology enabled transformations is highly regarded, but we’re more interested in your business transformation and change capability.

This is an opportunity to play a key role in one of our major ANZ transformation initiatives influencing how our people work, how our processes operate and how the business is enabled for the future. You’ll work closely with senior leaders and cross functional teams, with the opportunity to make a visible and lasting impact across the organisation.

Job Description

The role serves as the Finance subject matter expert for Treasury and Intercompany processes, partnering with Finance, Tax, GCC, Internal Controls, and IT teams to deliver standardized, scalable, and compliant solutions across global deployments.

The individual will be responsible for defining business requirements, validating solution designs, supporting testing activities, and ensuring successful deployment and adoption of Treasury, Banking, Intercompany, and Foreign Currency Valuation processes.

Responsibilities (Duties that must be performed on a regular basis)

- Lead the design and deployment of Treasury, Cash Management, Bank Accounting, Intercompany, and Foreign Currency Valuation processes.
- Define business requirements and drive process standardization across regions.
- Partner with IT and implementation teams to ensure solutions meet business and accounting requirements.
- Govern Treasury and Intercompany master data, process standards, and control requirements.
- Support the design and validation of bank account structures, house banks, payment processes, liquidity management, cash reporting, and cash pooling structures.
- Own the design, governance, and deployment of Foreign Currency Valuation processes, ensuring alignment with global accounting standards, Treasury requirements, and SAP best practices.
- Provide expertise on cash pooling strategies, liquidity optimization, and banking structures across multiple countries.
- Ensure compliance with accounting policies, internal controls, audit requirements, and statutory obligations.
- Facilitate solution design workshops and support key business decisions.

jobs.location: Kitt Green, United Kingdom
jobs.description:
Job Title: Site Financial Controller

﻿ Our Business

Kraft Heinz is one of the world’s largest food companies, dedicated to making life delicious for consumers across
the globe. Our iconic brands are found in millions of homes, bringing people together and creating memorable
moments every day. At Kraft Heinz, we’re driven by a passion for quality, continuous improvement, and doing the
right thing. We champion great people, embrace diversity, and foster a culture of innovation and accountability.

Kitt Green is Kraft Heinz’s largest manufacturing site in Europe and one of the biggest food processing facilities in
the UK. Home to a passionate team and iconic products, including Heinz Baked Beanz and Soups, Kitt Green plays a
vital role in delivering high-quality, trusted brands to millions of consumers every day.

We’re proud of our recent investment in advanced Heat Pump technology, a major step forward in energy
efficiency and our sustainability journey. Looking ahead, we’re planning significant improvements, further enhancing our commitment to quality and operational excellence. These initiatives reflect Kitt
Green’s ongoing focus on innovation, sustainability, and delivering results that matter.

If you’re eager to make a meaningful impact and help shape the future of food, Kraft Heinz is the place to grow
your career.

Role Summary

We’re looking for an experienced and motivated Finance leader to head up the Site Finance Team at Kitt Green. The
Site Financial Controller provides overall financial leadership and stewardship for Kraft Heinz’s largest European
manufacturing site, ensuring strong governance, accurate and timely reporting, and high-quality decision support to
drive performance, efficiency, and compliance.

This role leads a team covering the site’s major cost and performance areas, including circa £50m of ZBB costs per
annum and circa £50m of Variable Input Costs (including Direct Labour, Material Usage Variance, Utilities and Other
VIC), alongside critical compliance deliverables, inventory and product costing governance, and support to capital
investment justification and delivery.

The Site Financial Controller translates complex data into clear recommendations, champions continuous
improvement, and strengthens financial understanding across the site leadership team. The Kraft Heinz Management System encourages us to make informed choices using facts and data.

This role sits at the heart of the site leadership agenda and would suit someone who thrives in a fast-paced
environment, can balance strategic priorities with operational rigour, and enjoys working with colleagues at all levels
to deliver results that matter.

Direct Reports:                                                                              Reports into:

Manufacturing Finance Lead                                           European Operation Finance Lead
Finance Business Partner
Finance Analyst – Business Partnering
Finance Analyst - Manufacturing

Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership & Business Partnering
·       Set the direction for site finance, ensuring the right routines, insights and governance are in place to support the Site Leadership Team in delivering safety, quality, service and cost performance.
·       Act as trusted advisor to the Site Director, Heads of Manufacturing and Functional Heads, challenging constructively using facts and data and ensuring decisions are supported by robust analysis.
·       Build financial understanding across the site by translating complex data into clear actions and trade-offs, supporting a culture of ownership and accountability.
·       Champion continuous improvement by ensuring finance is an enabler of 90 Day Improvement Plans, Savings Initiatives and Capex projects (from justification through to benefits tracking).

Operational Finance, Cost Control & Monthly Financial Reporting
·       Own the site’s end-to-end financial performance management, ensuring high-quality reporting and review routines across both ZBB and VIC, with clear actions to close gaps to AOP/Latest Estimate.
·       Ensure timely and accurate month end close, including review of provisions, corrections, allocations and key judgements, and strong balance sheet ownership across the site.
·       Oversee cost center reporting and review meetings with operational and functional leads, ensuring the right level of insight, challenge and follow-through.
·       Ensure robust commentary and story-telling for key site reporting packs (e.g., MBR / Forecast decks) and align the narrative across Finance and Operations.

Budgeting & Forecasting
·       Lead the site planning calendar for Finance, coordinating the annual planning cycle and monthly forecasting routines across ZBB and VIC.
·       Ensure strong scenario modelling and risk/opportunity management, proactively surfacing issues early and agreeing mitigation actions with the business.
·       Oversee the site’s input to AOP Standard Setting (fixed and variable elements), ensuring assumptions are robust, consistent and well-governed.

Product Costing, Inventory & Working Capital Stewardship
·       Provide governance over product costing processes at site (raw, packaging, SFG/FG as applicable), including discipline around master data changes and master recipes.
·       Oversee inventory controls and provisions (including Supply Chain Loss Provisions, blocked/obsolete stock and disposals/recharges), ensuring timely action and clear root-cause follow-up with Supply Chain and Operations.
·       Ensure working capital levers are visible, measured and actively managed through clear routines.

Financial Compliance & Controls
·       Ensure the site operates with strong financial stewardship and compliance with corporate financial policies, internal control requirements and regulatory expectations.
·       Own audit readiness and lead responses to audit queries, ensuring documentation is accurate, timely and complete (including Annual Stock Take, fixed asset verification and other control activities).
·       Ensure site finance processes are documented, maintained and continuously improved (process maps, SOPs, ways of working).

People Leadership & Team Development
·       Lead, coach and develop the Site Finance Team, setting clear priorities, role clarity and development expectations, and ensuring effective coverage and succession planning.
·       Build a “Power of We” culture with Operations and Support Functions, breaking down silos and enabling fast, aligned execution.
·       Create an environment where finance colleagues can grow their technical capability, business partnering skills, and confidence in challenging constructively

Expected Experience and Required Skills

·       Qualified accountant (CIMA / ACCA / ACA) with significant experience in manufacturing / FMCG or similarly complex operational environment, including leadership responsibility.
·       Strong working knowledge of cost accounting, forecasting, planning, and performance management in a site-based setting.
·       Proven ability to translate complex analysis into clear decisions and actions with senior operational stakeholders; confident to challenge constructively using facts and data.
·       Strong governance mindset with experience of internal controls, audit readiness and timely resolution of queries (inventory, fixed assets, balance sheet ownership).
·       Advanced use of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word and PowerPoint; strong ERP capability (SAP or similar).
·       Organized, structured, and able to manage competing priorities while maintaining a high bar for quality and timeliness.
·       A people leader who coaches performance, builds capability, and creates clarity of ownership across the team.
·       Curious, positive and proactive; applies continuous improvement mindset to simplify and standardise ways of working (KHMS mindset).

What we offer

At Kraft Heinz, we believe great people drive our success. When you join our team at Kitt Green, you’ll benefit from:
·        Recognition & Reward: Competitive salary and benefits, plus recognition for your achievements and contributions.
·        Learning & Development: Access to world-class training, including the Kraft Heinz Management System and a range of technical and personal development courses through our Ownerversity portal.
·        Career Growth: Opportunities to develop your skills, take on new challenges, and progress your career within a global organization.
·        Inclusive Culture: A supportive, diverse, and collaborative environment where you can bring your whole self to work.
·        Sustainability & Innovation: The chance to be part of the site’s ongoing journey to excellence.
·        Community & Impact: Work that matters—helping to feed millions and make a difference in people’s lives.
·        Site-Specific Perks: A variety of salary sacrifice benefits, such as Tusker car scheme, private health cover, childcare vouchers, cycle to work scheme, additional holiday purchase scheme. The option to WFH two days each month, access to an on-site canteen, opportunity to join volunteering days each year.

Job Description
Objective:

Liderar la planeación financiera, control, proyección y optimización de los presupuestos de People, asegurando visibilidad financiera, disciplina de las rutinas de ZBB y correcta ejecución de los costos de personal y gastos operacionales. Actuar como socio financiero del equipo de People y de Finanzas, traduciendo la estrategia de personas en supuestos, escenarios y decisiones financieras sostenibles, con controles robustos y una gobernanza regional consistente.

Key Activities/ Deliverables:

jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Purpose
​​The Product & Package Assurance Strategy Principal Scientist is accountable for embedding benchmarking as a practical, enterprise way of working that helps teams maintain & improve Kraft Heinz product and package in-market performance. This role defines the enterprise operating model, aligns senior leaders on program vision and scope, and builds the communication system that turns program outputs into shared focus and action. You will lead robust annual product status update discussions, using structured cross-functional inputs & benchmarking results to inform targeted action for strong product/pack performance.  You will build systems that keep the program operating smoothly at an enterprise level: program goals, dashboards, impact tracking, communication cadence for LT updates. You will also enable automation (financial pulls, portfolio views, priority identification) so that teams spend less time chasing inputs and more time acting on results - so teams can strengthen in-market product and packaging performance.
​
Overview of the CX Product & Package Assurance Team
The CX Product Insights Product & Package Assurance Team maintains & strengthens in-market product and packaging performance by translating consumer experience signals into clear direction that R&D and cross-functional partners can use to improve products. Their benchmarking program provides consistent, comparable measurement of product and packaging experiences to identify performance gaps, diagnose drivers, and track improvement over time.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities
- ​​Align executives on benchmarking program vision, scope, decision uses, product selection, and annual operating cadence across business units.

- ​Stand up enterprise governance: intake, prioritization, decision rights, and escalation paths; drive stakeholder alignment on test plans.

- ​Build and maintain enterprise dashboards and reporting that communicate progress, success criteria, and implications for leadership.

- ​Automate core program operations (ex: financial pulls, portfolio views, priority identification) in partnership with Finance/Analytics/Tech.

- ​Lead annual product status update with cross-functional inputs to revisit and get a pulse on current product & pack performance, formulation updates, & in-market dynamics (with Ops, Nutrition, Regulatory, etc.)

- ​Develop and embed quarterly tracking system to ensure action items are visible and prioritized as projects.

- ​Create the communication strategy and rhythms (LT updates, cross-BU forums, standard readout formats) that reinforce adoption and make the program “sticky”

- ​Drive socialization and training within & outside R&D to embed common language, adoption, and expectations for the benchmarking program.

- ​Connect across business units to ensure consistent enterprise rollout, transparency, and comparability of program outputs.

- ​Track program health (adoption, timeliness, stakeholder satisfaction) and drive corrective actions to improve engagement & actionable outputs.​

- ​Bias toward standardization and process improvement; able to simplify ambiguity into clear plans and ownership.

jobs.location: Glenview R&D Center, Illinois, United States of America
jobs.description:
Job Description
Job Purpose

​ ​ The   Director, R&D - Digital Transformation   is a senior   leader responsible for defining the digital transformation strategy for the   NA   R&D organization and building the capabilities required to deliver it. This is a greenfield role , as   the Director will   establish   the vision, design the operating model, and develop the target-state organizational structure and multi-year resourcing plan needed to scale a high-performing, multidisciplinary Digital R&D function. The role   will have   three to four direct reports   to support our digital transformation agenda , with organizational design and hiring owned directly by this leader.

In practice, the Director leads a centralized Digital   NA   R&D Hub ,   partnering with   the NAZ Platforms,   R&D   and IT   teams to deploy predictive models, AI-enabled tools, advanced data architectures, and digital twin capabilities that accelerate innovation, reduce physical iteration, and shorten time-to-market.   This individual will drive the definition,   development   and adoption of the new digital workflows and ways of working for the R&D Organization.   This leader sits at the intersection of food and materials science,   process and packing engineering,   data science, and manufacturing   and will closely collaborate across functions and disciplines to bring the transformation agenda to reality.
​

Essential   Functions &   Responsibilities

- ​ ​ Own the R&D digital transformation agenda. Translate organizational ambition into a phased, prioritized strategic roadmap ,   defining required capabilities, sequencing investments, and securing senior leadership alignment and resources. Connect the roadmap directly to enterprise value: top-line growth,   productivity ,   sustainability commitments, and time-to-market competitiveness.

- ​ Own   organizational design for the   NA   Digital R&D   team . Define the target-state team structure, capability architecture, and workforce plan   required   to   operate   at scale.   Determine   the   optimal   mix of internal talent, external hires, and strategic partners. Establish hiring profiles and development pathways for a multidisciplinary team spanning data science, ML engineering, and R&D domain   expertise , including but not limited to Product Development, Consumer Science, Process and Package Development.

- ​ Lead integration of legacy PLM, ELN, and LIMS systems into a cohesive data platform   in partnership with R&D Transformation.   Define governance protocols ensuring ingredient specifications, packaging tolerances, sensory data, and process parameters share a universal taxonomy. Establish the data quality standards and ingestion pipelines   required   to power reliable AI and predictive analytics at scale.

- ​ Lead development and deployment of physics /engineering /chem -based simulation, machine learning, and generative AI models that predict   consumer acceptance/behaviors,   formulation   performance, process behavior, shelf-life, and packaging integrity prior to physical trials. Define   MLOps   infrastructure and model governance practices to move from proof-of-concept to production-grade tools.   Guide build-vs-buy   decisions for digital R&D platforms   in partnership with IT

- ​ Design and operationalize a scalable Hub-and-Spoke engagement model enabling rapid, repeatable adoption of digital tools across   Central and Platform   R&D teams. Establish workflows, decision rights, and governance mechanisms to support effective collaboration across geographies and disciplines.

- ​ Recruit, develop, and   retain   professionals who can translate between scientific problem statements and digital solutions. Champion digital fluency across the broader R&D organization through training, embedded Spoke partnerships, and storytelling that connects digital tools to commercial outcomes.

- ​ Serve as the senior advocate for digital R&D transformation. Build cross-functional coalitions with R&D, Operations, IT, Marketing, and Quality. Drive adoption through proof-of-concept delivery, measurable value creation, and consistent executive engagement.   ​

People Management Responsibilities

- Team (salaried ):   2   to   4   direct reports .

Key Outputs & Deliverables

-   Innovation Velocity & Market Impact

- Time-to-Market Reduction: Decrease in   idea -to-commercialization cycle time for new product development and packaging transitions . Reduce number of line trials and associated   cost .

- Agile Sprint Velocity: Digital innovation sprints completed per quarter resulting in   a viable   commercial brief

- Right- First-Time : Increase overall quality of delivery of projects, measured as % of right   first time   initiatives to market (no intervention needed after launch)

- Organizational Design & Capability Build

- Org Design Completion: Approved future-state organizational structure and resourcing roadmap delivered within 12 months

- Transformation Roadmap Adoption: Executive-aligned digital R&D strategy approved within 6 months

- Resource Efficiency & Predictive Accuracy

- Physical Iteration Reduction: Decrease in benchtop iterations or pilot plant /plant trial   runs   required   per project , and associated cost and resource reduction

- Model Correlation: Statistical correlation between digital twin/simulation model outcomes and actual physical results

- Organizational Adoption & Data Quality

- Spoke Utilization Rate: Percentage of active R&D projects incorporating predictive modeling or digital sensory analysis into their stage-gate process.

- Data Quality Index: Rolling metric measuring completeness, accuracy, and   standardization of data ingested into the central ontology

Expected Experience   & Required Skills

- ​ ​ Bachelor’s degree   in engineering, data science, computer science, food science, or a related technical field   with 17 years of relevant experience   OR   M aster’s degree   with 16 years of relevant experience   OR   PhD with 15 years of relevant experience

- ​ 12+ years leading digital, analytics, or advanced technology initiatives within R&D, manufacturing, or product development, with   demonstrated   growth in scope and organizational impact

- ​ Proven   track record   defining ,   not just executing,   digital   transformation strategy in a complex, matrixed   CPG   or food & beverage environment

- ​ Demonstrated experience in organizational design and workforce planning: building team structures, hiring roadmaps, and scaling functions from   early stage   to operational maturity

- ​ Experience managing   and interacting in   multidisciplinary teams

- ​ Deep technical fluency in   one or more of the   following:   food science, product development, chemical /mechanical   engineering, and/or packaging development

- ​ Strong foundational knowledge of machine learning, generative AI, computational modeling, and modern data architecture (data lake s , data mesh,   MLOps )

- ​ Familiarity with R&D enterprise systems (PLM, ELN, LIMS) and associated data interoperability challenges

- ​ Ability to define a compelling transformation vision and connect R&D capability directly to enterprise value

- ​ Skilled at navigating legacy corporate cultures, aligning cross-functional stakeholders, and   establishing   clear decision rights over data governance and digital protocols

- ​ Entrepreneurial orientation: comfortable with ambiguity, building from scratch, and making sound decisions with incomplete information

- ​ Executive presence sufficient to influence at the   senior executive   level and represent the digital R&D agenda with external partners and industry peers ​

Work Environment & Schedule

This position   operates   primarily in a hybrid work environment and is based at the Kraft Heinz R&D Innovation Center   located   in Glenview, IL. Our hybrid model provides flexibility based on business needs, allowing employees to work virtually up to two days per week, with an expectation to work on-site at least three days per week at the Glenview Innovation Center.

Offering Sponsorship:   We’re   able to offer sponsorship for this role.

jobs.description:
Overview

Decision Intelligence aims to identify risks and provide action recommendations to resolve them, in order to support and eventually automate human decision-making. As a Manager in the Decision Intelligence Pod within the Digital Supply Chain team, you will play a key role in leading the creation and implementation of a product roadmap that supports our Digital Supply Chain strategy. You will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical developers as we strive to build new DI tools and skills.

You will build a deep understanding of the targeted business practices and build close relationships with key business stakeholders to ensure that the development team’s effort is aligned with our business objectives. You will be responsible for key features that will transform the routines and ways of working of several teams in the supply chain, and you will deliver a tremendous amount of impact and value to the business.

Examples of projects in the Decision Intelligence Pod include tools for the optimal prioritization of inventory on quality hold, the level-loading of warehouse labor, the proper maintenance of our master data, the creation and evaluation of our short-term production plan, the mitigation of short-term service risks, and the avoidance of waste driven by code date rotation issues.

Job Description
You can expect the following responsibilities as a Manager in the Decision Intelligence Pod within the Digital Supply Chain team:

- Establish clear project goals based on the overarching Decision Intelligence strategy and the specific desired business impact.
- Work closely with business stakeholders to ensure the digital vision aligns with their own business strategy and product requirements.
- Translate business requirements and user needs into specific tasks to be carried out by developers (data engineers, data scientists, BIEs, etc).
- Lead the development process end-to-end, from design and discovery to deployment and change management.

- Act as an owner in the Digital Supply Chain team, solving problems as needed to deliver value to KraftHeinz.

Qualifications

- 3-5 years of business experience (supply chain experience preferred).
- Education: undergraduate degree (engineering background preferred).

Why Us?

We're  accelerating our ambition to become a best-in-class Digital leader by making data-driven investments that drive smarter business decisions. jobs.location: Chicago/Aon Center, Illinois, United States of America
jobs.description:
Job Description
Here at Kraft Heinz, we grow our people to grow our business, because we believe that great people make great companies. When you join our table, you can expect access to an array of holistic wellness benefits* and perks, including medical, dental and vision coverage, 7% 401(k) matching, Business Resource Groups (BRGs) to help foster diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all employees, an industry-leading total rewards package that emphasizes a high discretionary bonus.

*Benefits begin immediately upon hire for salaried employees.

Get a peek into life here at Kraft Heinz through our  Instagram  and  TikTok  channels!

Associate Director, Advanced Analytics - Growth & Manufacturing at a glance...
You will lead the advanced analytics Growth & Manufacturing function at Kraft Heinz, building and deploying AI, ML, and BI solutions that drive data-informed decision-making—with particular focus on unlocking value in marketing effectiveness (MMM, consumer segmentation, market opportunities), R&D innovation pipelines (predictive modeling, ingredient analytics, NPD forecasting), and manufacturing performance (OEE optimization, predictive maintenance)—to accelerate KHC's digital transformation and AI strategy.

What's on the menu?
- Define and execute the advanced analytics roadmap aligned to KHC's AI and digital transformation strategy, with priority activations in marketing analytics, R&D predictive modeling, and manufacturing optimization.

- Lead and develop a high-performing team of analysts and data scientists, fostering innovation, agile delivery, and continuous improvement.

- Partner with the Director of Analytics Products to shape KHC's Analytics strategy, with specific emphasis on Growth & Manufacturing applications across marketing (content personalization, creative analytics), R&D (formulation assistance, literature mining), and manufacturing (anomaly detection, process automation).

- Collaborate with Marketing to deploy advanced analytics: MMM, consumer segmentation, campaign attribution, and brand performance forecasting.

- Partner with R&D/Innovation to develop predictive models for innovation pipeline prioritization, ingredient performance analytics, and consumer trend forecasting.

- Work with Manufacturing on OEE optimization, predictive maintenance, and quality analytics to reduce waste and improve throughput.

- Partner with L&D to build Analytics and AI literacy, responsible AI education, and adoption programs across the enterprise.

- Champion agile delivery; work with product owners and scrum masters to translate business requirements into analytics user stories and deliver value in iterative sprints.

Recipe for Success - apply now if this sounds like you!
- I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or related quantitative field.

- I have 7+ years in analytics, data science, or a related field and 3+ years in people management.

- I have a demonstrated track record of deploying ML/AI solutions in at least 2 of the following 3 domains:

- 1. Marketing Analytics: MMM, campaign attribution, consumer segmentation, brand performance forecasting

- 2. R&D / Innovation Analytics: Predictive pipeline modeling, ingredient/formulation analytics, NPD demand forecasting

- 3. Manufacturing / Supply Chain Analytics: Demand forecasting, OEE optimization, predictive maintenance, quality analytics

- I have agile delivery experience in an analytics or product context.

- I have experience in Python, R, SQL, PowerBI or an equivalent BI platform, ML/statistical modeling, generative AI application development and prompt engineering, and cloud data platforms.

- I have experience leading a team, developing talent, managing executive stakeholder relations, and influencing cross-functionally.

- I have experience leading change management for technology adoption.

- I have experience in the following domains: Marketing analytics methodologies (MMM, attribution); R&D innovation processes and sparse data environments; manufacturing KPIs (OEE, yield, MTBF) and supply chain forecasting principles.

- I have experience with Agile/scrum methodology; product thinking and user story development; data governance and responsible AI principles.

Licenses and Certifications:
None required. Preferred: cloud platform certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP); ML framework credentials. PMP or SAFe agile certification a plus.

jobs.location: Chicago/Aon Center, Illinois, United States of America
jobs.description:
Job Description

About the Function

Business Development is a newly established function within the North America zone responsible for leading Strategic and Transformation projects, driving Digital initiatives, enabling the Integrated Commercial Business Plan (ICBP), and supporting and governing the Annual Business Cycle (ABC/1YP) and zone Strategy. The function acts as a connective layer between commercial teams, functional leaders, and zone leadership — translating strategic priorities into structured plans and disciplined execution.

Job Purpose

The Senior Analyst, Business Development – Annual Business Cycle and Strategy will support, enable, and help govern the 1-3 Year Plans processes for the North America zone. This role connects Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain to ensure commercial and operation plans are aligned, well-governed, and grounded in a disciplined planning cadence — enabling the zone to translate strategy into an executable, trackable plans.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

Annual Business Cycle (ABC/1-3YP)

- Support the planning, coordination, and governance of the Annual Business Cycle (ABC) and One/Three-Year Plan (1-3YP) processes for the zone, ensuring timelines, templates, and deliverables are met.
- Prepare high-quality materials (analyses, decks, scorecards) that support leadership decision-making during planning and business review cycles.
- Act as a trusted business partner and connective point across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain, building strong relationships that enable alignment without formal authority.
- Translate commercial strategy (innovation, distribution, pricing, promotion) into clear planning inputs and ensure they are reflected accurately.

Expected Experience & Required Skills
Experience

- Experience in commercial planning, marketing or sales strategy, category/business planning, IBP/S&OP, or related commercial roles.
- Experience with formal business planning cycles (IBP, S&OP, AOP/1YP, or similar) preferred.

Skills & Competencies

Commercial background: Commercial acumen with the ability to connect demand, investment, and financial drivers to business outcomes; comfortable working with revenue, volume, and margin data.

Project management: Strong organizational and planning skills; able to manage multiple complex workstreams, deadlines, and stakeholders concurrently.

Digital savviness: Comfortable working with planning tools, dashboards, data analytics and AI platforms; curious about how digital tools and AI can streamline commercial planning.

Flexibility & comfort with ambiguity: Able to operate in a dynamic, fast-changing environment and adjust quickly as priorities and business conditions evolve.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: Ability to synthesize data from multiple sources into clear, decision-ready insights.

Excellent communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills: Ability to influence senior leaders without direct authority.

Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and AI platforms; familiarity with planning/ERP systems (e.g., SAP) and BI tools (e.g., Power BI) a plus.

Attitude & Mindset

Positive, can-do attitude: Approaches challenges with energy, optimism, and solution orientation.

Attitude to learn: Genuine intellectual curiosity; proactively builds new commercial, financial, and digital knowledge; comfortable learning fast in a new function.

Commitment to quality: Consistently strives to deliver polished, high-quality work product and experiences to stakeholders, even under time pressure and tight planning deadlines.

Resilience & adaptability: Thrives amid ambiguity and change; stays composed and effective during high-pressure planning cycles.

Ownership mindset: Acts like an owner of outcomes, not just tasks; follows through on commitments and holds self and others accountable.

jobs.description:
Job Description
Associate Manager – Continuous Improvement
Global Procurement Solutions | Ahmedabad, India
Role Overview
We are seeking results-driven Continuous Improvement expert to drive operational excellence and transformation initiatives across business processes, systems, and services. This role is responsible for identifying improvement opportunities, driving process optimization, implementing automation and digital solutions, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. The successful candidate will partner with business leaders, functional teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to improve efficiency, quality, compliance, customer experience, and business outcomes. The role requires strong analytical skills, project management expertise, change leadership capabilities, and a passion for driving sustainable improvements, and data-driven decision-making.
Key Responsibilities
Process Improvement and Transformation
·       Lead end-to-end continuous improvement initiatives across operational and business processes.
·       Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and process gaps using data analysis and stakeholder feedback.
·       Design and implement process improvements that enhance productivity, quality, and customer experience.
·       Standardize processes and establish best practices across teams and functions.
·       Drive business transformation projects aligned with organizational objectives.
Operational Excellence
·       Establish process governance frameworks and performance management mechanisms.
·       Drive adoption of operational excellence principles throughout the organization.
Digitalization & Automation
·       Partner with technology teams to deliver automation and system enhancement initiatives.
·       Support implementation of analytics, dashboards, and reporting solutions to improve visibility and decision-making.
·       Evaluate emerging technologies to accelerate business transformation.
Project Management & Change management
·       Manage multiple improvement projects from ideation through implementation and benefit realization.
·       Develop project plans, milestones, risk mitigation strategies, and communication plans.
·       Lead change management activities and ensure stakeholder engagement throughout project lifecycles.
·       Monitor project savings, efficiency gains, and business impact.
·       Establish performance metrics to track productivity, service quality, compliance, and customer satisfaction.
·       Measure and report realized benefits from improvement initiatives.
Stakeholder management
·       Partner with business leaders, operations teams, technology teams, and functional stakeholders to understand business challenges.
·       Facilitate workshops, process mapping sessions, and improvement forums.
·       Influence stakeholders and build alignment around transformation priorities.
·       Act as a trusted advisor on operational excellence and continuous improvement strategies.
Required Skills & Experience
- Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.
- 7+ years of experience in Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence, Business Transformation, Shared Services, Supply Chain, Procurement, or Process Excellence.
- Proven experience leading cross-functional improvement initiatives.
- Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
- Experience managing process transformation and change initiatives.

Job Description
Lead, HR Manager, WHQ People & Performance
Location: Chicago, Illinois

As the Lead, HR Manager, WHQ People & Performance , you will serve as a senior, globally focused HR Business Partner who connects complex business strategy with practical, high-impact execution.

Reporting directly to the Head of People & Performance for Finance, Global Technology, and P&P , you will lead the people strategy for a global organization of approximately 230 employees across 20 countries . You will have autonomous P&P responsibility across five core global hubs: the United States, Canada, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and India .

In this highly visible role, you will advise and support approximately four to eight executive-level leaders , directly manage two Senior Analysts , and partner across our global P&P network to deliver talent strategies that strengthen organizational performance, leadership capability, employee engagement, and retention.

What’s on the Menu?

Strategic HR Business Partnership
- Develop and execute comprehensive P&P strategies for a global employee population of approximately 230 people across 20 countries.

- Serve as a trusted advisor and talent coach to four to eight executive-level leaders, providing strategic counsel on workforce priorities, organizational effectiveness, leadership capability, and employee matters.

- Provide autonomous P&P leadership across the United States, Canada, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and India.

jobs.description:
​The Procurement Manager for Innovation connects Kraft Heinz business strategy, brand ambition, and supplier capability to bring new products to life. This role sits at the center of innovation, partnering across the business and with external suppliers to identify new concepts, unlock emerging technologies, and enable strong commercialization outcomes. This innovation procurement role is designed to embed procurement early in the innovation process, anticipate future supplier capabilities, and translate business and brand strategy into scalable supplier solutions. The role also connects business unit innovation with core procurement teams — including Ingredients, Packaging, and External Manufacturing — to ensure preferred supplier alignment, supplier readiness, contracting, and seamless launch execution. For externally manufactured innovation, this role leads end-to-end sourcing and commercialization support, from supplier selection and contracting through onboarding, development, launch, and early lifecycle management. After launch, the role ensures a smooth transition to the appropriate base business procurement team. The ideal candidate is strategic, collaborative, digitally savvy, and energized by the opportunity to shape what’s next. They are curious by nature, strong in influence and storytelling, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and passionate about building supplier partnerships that accelerate innovation and drive growth.

Job Description
Primary   Responsibilities

- ​ ​ Partner with brand, business, and cross-functional teams to understand innovation strategy, pipeline priorities, and future capability requirements

- ​ Identify   and develop supplier partners that can enable innovation strategy,   conduct continuous landscape assessments for the category,   elevate commercialization, and unlock new growth opportunities   through proactively shaping supplier partnerships to meet business needs

- ​ Bring forward   innovation   concepts, supplier capabilities, and emerging technologies by building strong external partnerships and staying connected to market developments

- ​ Serve as a key connector between business unit innovation and core procurement teams, including Ingredients, Packaging, and External Manufacturing, to   align   preferred suppliers, supplier readiness, contracting, and launch support   for internally manufactured innovation

- ​ Support internal innovation commercialization by ensuring procurement readiness and strong coordination across the relevant procurement categories and stakeholders

- ​ Lead external manufacturing sourcing and commercialization activities for applicable innovation projects, including supplier identification, strategic sourcing, commercial negotiation, IP and CAPEX considerations, contracting, onboarding, and supplier ways-of-working setup

- ​ Act as the primary point of contact for external manufacturing innovation partners through development, commercialization, launch, and early lifecycle support

- ​ Drive supplier relationship management for innovation partners, including performance management, collaboration routines, issue resolution, and launch readiness

- ​ Lead problem solving during commercialization and launch to ensure speed, continuity, and strong cross-functional execution

- ​ Transition launched products, supplier relationships, and contract ownership to the   appropriate   business   procurement team after stabilization

- ​ Conduct supplier and market landscape analysis to   identify   new partners, innovation opportunities, and competitive advantages

As a trusted HR partner, you will provide hands-on advice across the full employee lifecycle, including employee relations, performance management, talent development, workforce planning, recruitment and engagement initiatives.

- Use people insights and data to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
- Partner with recruitment teams to deliver effective hiring outcomes across the site.
- Support talent development, succession planning, engagement initiatives and performance processes.

- Experience supporting blue-collar and/or manufacturing, FMCG, logistics or similar operational workforces (highly desirable).
- Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to build trusted relationships at all levels.
- A practical, solutions-focused approach with the ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
- Experience using HR systems and data to support decision-making.

Our Company
The Kraft Heinz Company is revolutionizing the food industry – we will be the most profitable food company powered by the most talented people with unwavering commitment to our communities, leading brands and highest product quality in every category in which we compete. As a global food and beverage powerhouse, Kraft Heinz represents over $25 billion in revenue and is the 3rd largest food and beverage company in North America and 5th largest in the world. At Kraft Heinz, to be the BEST food company, growing a BETTER world is more than a dream – it is our GLOBAL VISION.  To be the best, we want the best – best brands, best practices and, most importantly, the best people.

Owners Only!
This is a role for someone who craves a global challenge balanced by the desire to be accountable for delivering a best practice model in the Global Center of Excellence at Kraft Heinz.  It is both a strategic and a tactical position.  Those that do not want to get their hands dirty or build out a function without buying pre-packaged solutions should not apply.

Global Group Lead, Commodity Risk Management –Packaging and Energy at a glance ...
Reporting to the Global Head of Commodity Risk Management, the Global Group Lead is responsible for ~1.5-2 billion USD global spend. The categories are complex and volatile from a Global Supply Chain and Price Risk Management perspective. The individual in this position should be a commodity risk management expert, with a strong background in leading and developing strong teams, with a demonstrated capability to develop a holistic global price risk management strategy for multiple categories. The individual should drive and challenge the team to reach targets and provide solid advice on all related markets and supply issues to senior leadership.

Key Ingredients:
- Develop and lead a high performing team of risk managers managing Packaging and Energy commodity portfolios, and support the function with best in class Market Insights, Research and Compliance.

- Oversight of and responsibility for the Global Commodity Risk Management program for assigned portfolio utilizing a hybrid of physical and financial instruments including futures, forward contracts, physical inventory, forecasting and communication to senior management.

- Design and implement effective short, mid, and long-term hedging strategies balancing external market drivers with internal goals and objectives of each business unit, and provide advanced risk analytics, market guidance and performance metrics to both regional and global business leaders.

- Coordinate strategy alignment throughout all the stakeholders in the Zone, gain approvals and document approved strategies for internal auditing.

- Coach and develop the team to manage price inflation and deflation focusing on both upside and downside market risks and contribute to their skills, development, and career planning.

- Lead weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly stakeholder alignment meetings to inform the zones and Global Procurement leaders of all Commodity positions, market outlooks and strategies.

- Utilize Zero Based Budgeting to justify cost and operate in a lean manner to maximize operating efficiency and speed of execution.

- Compliance, reporting and other duties:
- Ensure full compliance with the Kraft Heinz Global Commodity Risk Management and Hedging Policy

- Ensure full compliance with other Kraft Heinz policies including Procurement Policy and Code of Conduct Policy

- Ensure full compliance with any other internal guidelines and external regulations

- Ensure full compliance and support to all Kraft Heinz on social, environmental and sustainability projects

- Other projects and duties assigned by Kraft Heinz Management

- Minimum Bachelor's degree required, master’s degree preferred in a related field.
